verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookie consent or tracking opt-out controls. The items only address authentication, API reference, MCP/CLI channels, sandboxes, versioning and invoicing features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
